name: USW-Pro-XG-Aggregation
title: Switch Pro XG Aggregation
summary: 1U Layer 3 aggregation switch with 32x 25G SFP28 and Etherlighting; core for 10/25G fabrics.

extra.l3_scope: inter-VLAN/static routing/DHCP for local networks; no OSPF/BGP listed

gotchas: SFP28 cages only — zero RJ45 data ports; every link needs an SFP28/SFP+ module or DAC.
No 100G QSFP28 uplink — 25G is the fastest port; for stacking/100G look at ECS-class.
480 mm deep, 7 kg: requires a 4-post rack (600–1066 mm post depth).
Single internal 200W PSU; redundancy only via external UniFi RPS.
L3 is static/inter-VLAN only (no dynamic routing listed); needs a UniFi console/gateway to adopt.
best_for: 10/25G core aggregating Pro XG / Pro Max switches
